snippet.title: Thronefall | Craaghelm Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist on Steam: https://mythwright.gg/TF-Craaghelm

Conquer the mountain in Craaghelm, the first expansion for Thronefall. Coming this November on PC, Nintendo Switch alongside PS5 & XBOX (Thronefall base game on Game Pass).
